pkg.name: ant-design-pro
pkg.description: An out-of-box UI solution for enterprise applications

scripts.analyze: npx cross-env ANALYZE=1 node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run gh-pages
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:prettier && npm run tsc
scripts.preview: npm run build && node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js preview --port 8000
scripts.record: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=development REACT_APP_ENV=test node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js record --scene=login
scripts.start: npx cross-env UMI_ENV=dev node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js dev
scripts.start:dev: npx cross-env REACT_APP_ENV=dev MOCK=none UMI_ENV=dev node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js dev
scripts.start:no-mock: npx cross-env MOCK=none UMI_ENV=dev node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js dev
scripts.start:pre: npx cross-env REACT_APP_ENV=pre UMI_ENV=dev node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js dev
scripts.start:test: npx cross-env REACT_APP_ENV=test MOCK=none UMI_ENV=dev node node_modules/@umijs/max/bin/max.js dev

theme.preset-colors: pink, magenta, red, volcano, orange, yellow, gold, cyan, lime, green, blue, geekblue,

theme.pagination-font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'
